questions.stem: Which of the following fluoroquinolone has maximum Oral Bioavailability?
questions.solutionHtml:
Levofloxacin

  • Levofloxacin is an antibiotic, used in the treatment of bacterial infections in adults and children (;6 months age). It is also used in treating infections of the urinary tract, nose, throat, skin and lungs (pneumonia). It cures the infection by stopping the further growth of the causative microorganisms.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 764

questions.stem: Ciprofloxacin/fluoroquinolones are contraindicated in children because of which of the following side effect?
questions.solutionHtml:
They cause arthropathy
  • Fluoroquinolones are not recommended for use in infants and children.
  • Patients up to age 18 have not been included in clinical trials because fluoroquinolones caused lameness in immature dogs due to permanent lesions of the cartilage of weight-bearing joints


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 759

questions.stem: A 46-year-old male with chronic uti has been prescribed the drug norfloxacin. The mechanism of development of resistance against this drug is by all of the following except :
questions.solutionHtml:
Altered metabolic pathway

Altered metabolic pathway is the correct option.

questions.stem: A 36-year-old male has been prescribed fluoroquinolone for sinusitis. He developed photosensitivity after taking this drug. Which of the following drug would have been prescribed?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sparfloxacin

Sparfloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibiotic used in the treatment of bacterial infections. It has a controversial safety profile

questions.stem: A 52-year-old patient has been prescribed the drug gatifloxacin. This drug could have been prescribed for which of the following condition in this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Conjunctivitis

Conjunctivitis Inflammation of the transparent covering of the eye because of bacterial or viral infection or allergic reaction. The eye appears swollen, and red with an itching sensation.



Goodman & Gilman's the pharmacological basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 1017
